articles.summary: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: MNSB MNSBP), the financial holding company for MainStreet Bank, reported a surging net income of $4.6 million and net interest margin of 3.75% for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, an increase of $2.1 million and 45 basis points from the previous quarter respectively.
